faq.erotisi_chreiazetai_logariasmos_gia_na_p: Do I need an account to order?
faq.apantisi_ochi_mporeite_na_oloklirosete_t: No. You can complete your order as a guest — we only ask for what's needed to ship it to you. An account is required if you want order history or, for companies, partner pricing and credit payment.
faq.apantisi_nai_sto_210_411_1355_deytera: Yes, at 210 411 1355, Monday to Friday 08:00–16:30. If you have a list of codes, you can also paste them in bulk into the cart.
faq.erotisi_pos_xero_oti_yparchei_pragmatika: How do I know stock is real?
faq.apantisi_i_diathesimotita_sto_site_einai: Availability on the site is our ERP, not an estimate. Right now {inStock} out of {products} codes are immediately available. If it says "3 pcs.", there are 3.
faq.erotisi_den_vrisko_ton_kodiko_poy: I can't find the code I'm looking for.
faq.apantisi_i_anazitisi_dechetai_kodiko_kol: Search accepts Kolleris code, manufacturer code, and EAN. If you can't find it, we probably source it on order — give us a call. The online catalog is {products} codes from {brandslength} brands, but we distribute more.
faq.apantisi_ypologizetai_apo_to_chreosimo_v: It's calculated by chargeable weight and your postal code zone, not a flat fee. The exact amount is shown in the cart before you pay. Over {formatMoneyFREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD_NET} net value, shipping is free.
faq.apantisi_paraggelia_prin_tis_15_00_ergas: Orders before 15:00 on a business day ship the same day. Attica {etaAttica} business day, mainland Greece {etaMainland}, islands {etaIsland}, remote areas {etaRemote} business days.
faq.erotisi_mporo_na_paralavo_apo_to: Can I pick up from the store?
faq.apantisi_nai_apo_ton_peiraia_k_mayromich: Yes, from Piraeus (K. Mavromichali 4). Choose "Pick up from Piraeus" at checkout — the order is ready in 2 hours within business hours.
faq.erotisi_pos_parakoloytho_tin_paraggelia_: How do I track my order?
faq.apantisi_me_ton_arithmo_paraggelias_kai_: With your order number and email, on the tracking page — no account needed. Once the parcel ships, the ACS tracking number also appears.
faq.apantisi_nai_oles_kathe_timi_sto_site: Yes, all of them. Every price on the site is final, with VAT {DEFAULT_VAT_RATE}% (or the rate applicable to the item). The net value is shown below, for those who invoice.
faq.apantisi_karta_kai_iris_meso_viva_wallet: Card and IRIS via Viva Wallet, or bank transfer. Your card details never pass through our store. Approved corporate accounts can also pay on credit.
faq.erotisi_echete_timi_gia_epaggelmaties: Do you have a professional price?
faq.apantisi_nai_o_etairikos_logariasmos_din: Yes. A corporate account gives a permanent discount on the entire catalog — not a seasonal offer — along with invoicing and credit payment. The application is reviewed and usually activated within 2 business days.
faq.apantisi_giati_den_trechei_prosfora_tha_: Because there's no promotion running. We could show a struck-through price on two-thirds of the catalog — the difference between retail and eshop price exists — but a "discount" that always applies isn't a discount. When we run a real offer, you'll see it with the previous price next to it.
faq.apantisi_nai_sto_tameio_epilexte_thelo_t: Yes. At checkout select "I want an invoice" and provide the tax ID — we pull the rest of the details automatically from the AADE registry.
faq.erotisi_ti_eggyisi_echoyn_ta_ergaleia: What warranty do the tools have?
faq.apantisi_episimi_eggyisi_kataskeyasti_i_: Official manufacturer warranty. The duration varies by product and is listed on its page. Since we're an official distributor, service and parts go through us — not parallel import.
faq.apantisi_entos_14_imeron_ametacheiristo_: Within 14 days, unused, in its packaging and with the purchase receipt. Call us first for instructions — you'll save on shipping and time.
faq.erotisi_irthe_lathos_i_elattomatiko_ti: It arrived wrong or defective. What do I do?
faq.apantisi_tilefoniste_tin_idia_mera_sto_2: Call the same day at 210 411 1355. We cover the shipping costs for the replacement.
faq.erotisi_poia_i_diafora_idioti_kai: What's the difference between a personal and corporate account?
faq.apantisi_o_idiotis_echei_paraggelies_die: A private individual has orders, addresses, warranties, and returns. A corporate account adds partner pricing, invoicing, credit payment, and multiple users with roles and spending limits.
faq.erotisi_poso_kanei_na_egkrithei_o: How long does it take for the corporate account to be approved?
faq.apantisi_synithos_2_ergasimes_elegchoyme: Usually 2 business days. We check the VAT number, business activity, and any existing cooperation. Until then, you can place orders normally at retail prices.
faq.apantisi_nai_o_diacheiristis_tis_etairei: Yes. The company administrator invites users and assigns each one a role and a limit per order.
